extracted.intended_audience: securities exchanges, exchange counsel, market participants, and regulatory practitioners who file or track SEC rule filings
extracted.subtask_short: NYSE Arca rule change withdrawal notice
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Register notice informing the public that NYSE Arca withdrew a previously filed proposed rule change to modify its options fee schedule, with statutory and procedural citations for filing, effectiveness, publication, and withdrawal. Useful for people tracking rulemaking, filings under the Securities Exchange Act, and the public-inspection/official-publication procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing authority for proposed rule change
rubrics_metrics.description: The Exchange filed the proposed rule change pursuant to section 19(b)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Rule 19b-4 thereunder (File No. SR-NYSEARCA-2024-23).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Citations: 15 U.S.C. 78s(b)(1); 17 CFR 240.19b-4. Proposed rule changes should be filed under the statutory and rule provisions cited; include the file number and identify the filing party (here, NYSE Arca).

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate effectiveness upon filing when fee-related
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed rule change was immediately effective upon filing with the Commission pursuant to section 19(b)(3)(A) of the Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A proposed rule change may take effect upon filing if it is designated by the exchange as 'establishing or changing a due, fee, or other charge imposed by the self-regulatory organization on any person, whether or not the person is a member of the self-regulatory organization.' (15 U.S.C. 78s(b)(3)(A)(ii)). Use this statutory basis when claiming immediate effectiveness for fee or charge changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication for public comment
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed rule change was published for comment in the Federal Register (here, published March 19, 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed rule changes (even when filed as immediately effective) are published in the Federal Register for public notice and comment. Include publication citation (e.g., FR page/date) so stakeholders can locate the notice for comment and record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawal of a proposed rule change
rubrics_metrics.description: The Exchange withdrew the proposed rule change (SR-NYSEARCA-2024-23) on April 26, 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an exchange withdraws a previously filed proposal, a Federal Register notice documents the withdrawal and the associated file number and release number. The notice provides formal public record of the withdrawal; include dates and file/release identifiers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document headings and required metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Document headings vary by document type but may contain the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the number of the CFR title and the number of each part the document amends, proposes to amend, or is directly related to; the agency docket number / agency internal file number; and the RIN identifying the regulatory action in the Unified Agenda.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Document Drafting Handbook for more details. Note: repetition of headings to form internal navigation links has no substantive legal effect. Ensure filings include these metadata headings so the document is properly identified and linked in publication systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official content vs. prototype XML rendition
rubrics_metrics.description: The FederalRegister.gov XML rendition is a prototype and is not an official legal edition; the PDF linked in the document sidebar on govinfo.gov is the official electronic format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Those relying on Federal Register content for legal research should verify against the official edition on govinfo.gov; the XML rendition on FederalRegister.gov does not provide legal notice to the public or judicial notice to the courts until ACFR grants official status. Cite and rely on the official PDF for legal or formal uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public inspection and verification against final official edition
rubrics_metrics.description: Public Inspection: the PDF is FR Doc. 2024-09846 as it appeared on Public Inspection on 05/06/2024; users should verify contents against a final, official edition of the Federal Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only official editions of the Federal Register provide legal notice under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507. If using public inspection listings for legal research, verify the document contents against the final official edition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of agency dockets to display related documents
rubrics_metrics.description: FederalRegister.gov uses the agency dockets published with the document to display related documents (here File No. SR-NYSEARCA-2024-23 shows related documents and dates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include docket/file numbers in filings so related documents are linked and discoverable; related documents list helps stakeholders find the filing history (e.g., initial filing, publication, withdrawal).
